description: Unary NOT and unary minus, including ['unary', '-', operand].

cypher.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN NOT (p.active) AS inactive, -p.age AS negative_age

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN NOT (p.active) AS inactive, -p.age AS negative_age $$) AS (inactive agtype, negative_age agtype)

iso_gql.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN NOT (p.active) AS inactive, -p.age AS negative_age

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (NOT (p.active) AS inactive, -p.age AS negative_age))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (NOT (p.active) AS inactive, -p.age AS negative_age))
